# Golden Lady

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The Golden Lady has golden hair that falls all the way to her feet. She wears a gown that shimmers and shines entirely like living gold.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Personality

The Golden Lady is a skilled musician who spends her days playing a golden harp. Her music can be heard along the shore by those paying close attention.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

_Not yet known._

## Abilities

- plays all day on a golden harp  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

The Golden Lady was one of several whimsical, imaginary companions created by [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) in his letters detailing his life near the shore. According to Cedric's vivid descriptions, she joined him, [Nora](../character/nora.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../codex/places.md#twin-sailors) on fantastic adventures, such as sailing into the moon and journeying into the sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)_
